title: Fourier norm of a square
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f:\\{-1,1\\}^n\\to\\mathbb R$. The Fourier one-norm of the pointwise square of $f$ is at most the square of the Fourier one-norm of $f$.
